species.tagline: A strong beetle of Hong Kong's woodlands

tasks.title: Find the body parts
tasks.hint: Find the horn, antennae and six legs
tasks.message: The beetle has one big horn, two antennae and six legs.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! Look at this rhinoceros beetle. It has one big horn, two antennae, and six legs.

tasks.title: Open the wing cases
tasks.hint: Press "open shell" to see the flight wings
tasks.message: The hard wing cases open to reveal thin flight wings.
tasks.subtitle: Press to open its hard shell. Inside, it keeps a pair of thin flight wings folded away.

tasks.title: See through the shell
tasks.hint: Switch to X-ray mode to see the shell
tasks.message: The exoskeleton protects the body like armour.
tasks.subtitle: Press X-ray scan. Its hard shell turns clear, protecting the body just like armour.

tasks.title: See inside the body
tasks.hint: Look layer by layer: muscles, airways, gut and nerves
tasks.message: Inside there are flight muscles, airways, a gut and nerves.
tasks.subtitle: Look inside, layer by layer: flight muscles, breathing airways, the gut, and the nerves.

tasks.title: Protect the forest
tasks.hint: Help the beetle guard its forest home
tasks.message: The forest is the beetle's home, and we protect it together.
tasks.subtitle: This beetle lives in the forest. If we keep the forest clean, it can live safely. Thank you!
